The '''Marauder''' was a type of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] designed and produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The HOTAS control setup used in the Marauder was also used in the [[CR-17 Incendia III]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].
